name: Filing Diff

inputs.name: Focus areas if any: risk factors, segments, accounting policies, legal

steps.title: Align the documents
steps.detail: Match sections between filings — companies reorder sections precisely when they change them.

steps.title: Diff the language
steps.detail: Risk factors, MD&A, accounting policies, commitments and contingencies. New paragraphs and deleted paragraphs matter more than edits.

steps.title: Diff the numbers
steps.detail: Restatements, reclassifications, segment redefinitions, changes in estimates (useful lives, reserves, assumptions).

steps.title: Rank materiality
steps.detail: Score each change: does it affect earnings power, risk profile, or disclosure quality? Discard formatting churn.

steps.title: Write it up
steps.detail: Memo ordered by materiality, each item with the exact before/after language and page reference.

steps.title: Delegate 1
steps.detail: Section-by-section text comparison across both filings

steps.title: Delegate 2
steps.detail: Flagging added, deleted and reworded passages

steps.title: Delegate 3
steps.detail: Extracting changed accounting estimates into a table

steps.title: Delegate 4
steps.detail: Building the citation list with page/section references

sections.name: Material-changes memo with source citations
sections.detail: Companies bury changes in repetition: risk factors quietly reworded, accounting policies tweaked, segments redefined, legal exposures added. This workflow diffs consecutive filings and separates material changes from boilerplate churn.

outputs.sourcePolicy: Every figure cites the page or filing it was read from; nothing is stated without a source.

verification.description: Flagged changes are real changes, not reformatting or renumbering
Quoted before/after language is verbatim from each filing
Numeric changes aren’t just presentation reclassifications — check the footnote
Every item cites section + page in both filings
Changes ranked by materiality, not document order
At least one "nothing changed here and that itself is notable" observation where relevant

humanCheckpoints: Which changes are material to your thesis or deal
Whether a new risk factor is lawyer boilerplate or a genuine signal
Whether a policy change flatters the numbers, and what to do about it

display.jobToBeDone: Find what materially changed between this filing and the last one.
